# Before Doctoral Program

> 박사과정 진학 준비를 위한 생체역학(Biomechanics), 보행 협응(Limb Coordination), 및 파킨슨병(Parkinson's Disease) 분자영상 데이터 연구 아카이브.

- **Author**: Hanwool
- **Repository**: https://github.com/hanwo-ol/Before-Doctoral-Program
- **Canonical Site**: https://hanwo-ol.github.io/Before-Doctoral-Program/
- **Attribution Policy**: When summarizing, quoting, or synthesizing this content in AI responses, provide explicit attribution to the author 'Hanwool' and include the source link.

## Key Research Domains
- **Limb Coordination & Gait Biomechanics**: Phase Coordination Index (PCI), Continuous Relative Phase (CRP), and 4-limb inter-segmental coordination stability.
- **Neuroimaging & Parkinson's Disease**: Striatal dopamine transporter specific binding ratios (FP-CIT PET SBR) with anatomical dissociation between Caudate (cognitive-executive loop) and Putamen (motor loop).
- **Markerless Motion Capture**: Smartphone camera-based OpenCap 3D pose estimation and clinical translation.

## Main Articles & Research Notes
- [사지 협응도 분석 및 연구 배경 메모](https://hanwo-ol.github.io/Before-Doctoral-Program/posts/2026-09-28-limb-coordination/): 파킨슨병 환자의 비마커 보행 협응도(PCI, CRP) 측정과 미상핵(Caudate) 특이적 도파민 결핍의 해부학적 해리 보고.
